Synthetic HEIC fixture generated for the image attachment regression, with blue `4826` on a white 620 × 220 canvas. It contains no user data or third-party photograph.

Generated from the live harness's 5 × 7 digit font (`digitsPng('4826', 0, { scale: 20 })`) using macOS `sips -s format heic digits.png --out phone-digits.heic`. Decoding during tests is platform independent: the production WASM decoder reads this committed fixture on macOS, Linux and Windows.
